data.text: There are 199 reviews that were answered on September 1, 2018. Let me now summarize these reviews by computing key metrics:

args.purpose: Summarize reviews answered on 2018-09-01 with score distribution and sample comments
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_reviews,
    AVG(review_score) as avg_score,
    MIN(review_score) as min_score,
    MAX(review_score) as max_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as score_1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as score_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as score_3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as score_4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN review_score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as score_5,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN review_comment_title IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_title != '' THEN 1 END) as reviews_with_title,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_message != '' THEN 1 END) as reviews_with_message
FROM order_reviews 
WHERE DATE(review_answer_timestamp) = '2018-09-01'
